clips.send: Central Mountain Range. The island’s “spine”. Mountains and hills cover about two-thirds of Taiwan Island. Several ranges run north-northeast to south-southwest; the Central Mountain Range is the spine. The land is high in the middle and low around the edges: mountains in the centre and east, plains mostly in the west. clips.send: 台风。 多发于 7—9 月。 台风在温暖的太平洋洋面上形成，夏秋季节常常影响台湾、香港和澳门。 台风带来狂风暴雨，可能引发洪涝、山体滑坡，毁坏农作物。 台风降水也能补充水库。东部沿海和迎风山坡降水最多。 台风来，风大雨多；迎风坡雨最多。
